args.query: rate limiter using a Cloudflare Durable Object in a Worker

results.title: rate-limiter-flexible in-memory limiters
results.summary: Use rate-limiter-flexible's RateLimiterMemory to consume points, surface rejections with msBeforeNext and remainingPoints, apply blockDuration, penalty and reward, and guard requests with a framework-agnostic middleware tested offline against fake req/res objects.

results.title: Express 5 + Helmet + express-rate-limit hardening
results.summary: Add security headers with Helmet and per-IP rate limiting with express-rate-limit to an Express 5 API.

results.title: throttle-debounce rate limiting
results.summary: Wrap a counter with throttle-debounce debounce and throttle, asserting debounce collapses rapid calls and throttle limits rate using node:test fake timers, including cancel.

results.title: limits moving and fixed window rate limiting with memory storage
results.summary: Enforce moving and fixed window rate limits with the limits library and its in-memory storage, and test the sliding recovery and boundary burst gotchas offline with a controllable clock.

results.title: FastAPI endpoints rate limited with slowapi, tested with TestClient
results.summary: Add per-route and per-API-key rate limits to FastAPI with slowapi, then test 429 behavior offline with TestClient and the in-memory store.

results.title: Bottleneck rate limiting with concurrency, spacing and retries
results.summary: Throttle calls to a flaky API with Bottleneck using maxConcurrent, minTime spacing, priorities and automatic retries from the failed event, checked offline with timestamps.

results.title: aiolimiter AsyncLimiter guarding httpx AsyncClient offline
results.summary: Throttle an httpx AsyncClient with aiolimiter's leaky-bucket AsyncLimiter and test the burst, serialized concurrency, error and event-loop reuse gotchas fully offline with httpx.MockTransport.

results.title: dequal deep compare with object-hash digests
results.summary: Deep-compare nested objects, arrays, Maps, Sets and Dates with dequal, then compute stable object-hash digests using unorderedArrays and excludeKeys, fully offline.

results.title: dot-prop nested property paths
results.summary: Read, write, check and delete nested object properties with dot-prop using dotted paths, escaped dots and defaults, fully offline.

results.title: Structured JSON logs with python-json-logger, captured in tests
results.summary: Emit one JSON object per log record with python-json-logger 4.x, using extra fields, renamed keys, static fields, timestamp and exception info, and assert the parsed output offline.
